statement: For exact-arithmetic restarted conjugate gradients with restart length four on a real diagonal positive-definite matrix, if the initial residual has at most six active distinct eigenvalues, then the iteration either terminates or both normalized residual subsequences (r_{2j}/||r_{2j}||) and (r_{2j+1}/||r_{2j+1}||) converge. Consequently no instance in the frozen problem exists in dimension at most six, and 7 <= n_min(4) <= 8.
contribution: An exact exclusion of the previously undecided dimension six, obtained here from a two-block polynomial elimination and a sign-transport functional on the six-node resonant family. It is a strict partial result toward the frozen minimum-dimension problem; dimension seven remains open, and no priority claim is made beyond the focused primary-source comparison recorded in problem.md.
